universities.name: Rutgers University
universities.applicationPortal: Rutgers Application or Common App (students apply through one platform only)
scholarships: International Chancellor’s Scholarship: Up to $19,000/year for undergraduate
#YouAreWelcomeHere Scholarship: $19,000/year (two awards) for first-year undergraduate
F-1 International Visa Scholarship: Up to $17,000/year (for non-sponsored students)
Automatic Consideration: All admitted international students on valid non-immigrant visas automatically considered
Application Tip: Apply by Early Action or Regular Decision deadline for higher scholarship consideration
Graduate Support: Limited; on-campus employment and graduate assistantships available

universities.name: Boston University
universities.applicationPortal: Common Application OR Coalition Application (choose one; NOT both)
scholarships: Trustee Scholarship: Full tuition and fees (most prestigious; highly competitive)
Presidential Scholarship: 50% of tuition (approximately $25,000/year for UG)
College of Engineering FIRST Robotics Scholarship: For engineering applicants with FIRST robotics experience
Lu Lingzi Scholarship: For international graduate students (100% tuition + stipend)
William V. Shannon Memorial Fellowship: Graduate funding
Application Requirements: Apply by December 1 (UG) for merit scholarship consideration; mandatory application by deadline
Graduate Assistantships: Available with tuition remission and stipend (competitive; varies $57,868-$66,589 annually)
Important: International students NOT eligible for need-based financial aid from BU, state, or federal government

universities.name: Suny Buffalo University
universities.applicationPortal: SUNY App / Common App / Coalition App (Undergraduate); ubgradconnect.buffalo.edu/apply (Graduate)
scholarships: International scholarships: Yes (merit-based only)
Flagship Scholarship: Available to qualified international students; automatic consideration during admissions
UB Presidential Scholarship: For Honors College (most selective)
International Student Fee: $100/semester (Fall & Spring only)
Renewable scholarships: Up to 4 years with good academic standing (GPA 3.0+)
Internship Equity Fund: Up to $3,500 for unpaid internships (non-profits/government organizations)

universities.name: Arizona State University
scholarships: New American University (NAMU) Scholarship: Merit-based for international F-1 first-year and transfer students
Award: $6,000–$14,500 per year (varies based on achievement, community contribution, academics)
Automatic consideration upon admission (no separate application)
International Freshman Academic Award: For high-achieving international students who attended high school abroad
Typical awards: $2,000–$8,000 per year; 7–10% of students receive scholarships
Eligibility: High GPA, exceptional personal achievements, unique talents
Need-based aid: NOT available for international students
Teaching and Research Assistantships: May provide full tuition coverage + small living stipend
GEO Merit Scholarship: $2,000 (academic performance)
GEO International Student Scholarship: $2,000 (international students, academic performance)
GEO Access Scholarship: $2,000 (financial need + academic performance, ASU Online)
GEO Go Global Grant: $2,500 (demonstrated financial need)

universities.name: Georgia Institute of Technology
scholarships: Georgia state law prohibits financial aid (need- or merit-based) to international undergraduate students
Merit scholarships NOT available to international students
Limited emergency funds available (after 2 semesters of enrollment):
Anne Robinson Clough International Student Fund: $200–$400 one-time (F-1 visa holders, full-time, 2+ semesters completed)
Emergency tuition loans available on first-come, first-serve basis
Karishma Babu & Vijay Balasubramaniyan Fellowship Endowment Fund: $900 one-time (Indian graduate students; priority to female students or those in engineering/science/computing; F-1 visa required)
Graduate fellowships and assistantships: Limited availability; vary by program and department
Research Assistantships (RA) and Teaching Assistantships (TA) available in some programs (merit-based)
For All International Students:
On-campus employment: Up to 20 hours/week during semester (F-1 visa); full-time during breaks
Private student loans available (not recommended for high debt)
External scholarships from private/nonprofit organizations available

universities.name: North Carolina State University
scholarships: Link: https://financialaid.ncsu.edu/
Email: financialaid@ncsu.edu
Address: 341 Cashiers Building, Raleigh, NC 27695-7114
Link: https://www.ncsu.edu/
Address: 2701 Sullivan Drive, Raleigh, NC 27695
Academic Requirement: High school completion (Class 12 equivalent); no specific cutoff published; competitive GPA typically 3.5+ (85%+)
English Language Test: TOEFL iBT 80+ (minimum 18 per section) OR IELTS Academic 6.5+ (minimum 6.0 per band) OR Duolingo 110+ — REQUIRED for non-native English speakers (India NOT exempt)
Standardized Tests: SAT or ACT accepted; not mandatory but recommended
Additional Requirements: Official high school transcripts; Common App essays; official English translations of non-English documents
Academic Requirement: Bachelor’s degree (4-year equivalent); GPA 3.0+ (80%+); program-specific requirements vary

universities.name: Purdue University
scholarships: Merit-based awards: 15% of applicants receive merit scholarships annually
Automatic consideration upon admission; no separate application required
Criteria: Academic excellence, leadership, extracurricular activities, test scores
Award amounts: Varies (up to full tuition for top candidates)
No need-based aid for international students (public university)
Scholarship names include: Fulbright-Nehru Master’s Fellowship, Ross Fellowship, ACC (Arts & Cultural Management) scholarships
Merit-based awards: Available through individual departments
Teaching Assistantships (TA) & Research Assistantships (RA): Tuition waiver (partial to full) + stipend
MS Computer Science: GRE scores 308+ (revised), 153+ verbal, 155+ quantitative recommended for TA/RA
MBA scholarships: Limited merit awards; average GMAT 650+
Ross Fellowship (PhD): $24,124 annually + tuition + health insurance for 4 years
Fulbright-Nehru Fellowship: Fully funded for Master’s; requires 55%+ bachelor’s degree, 3+ years work experience

universities.name: Yale University
universities.applicationPortal: Varies by program (Yale online application system)
scholarships: Need-Blind Admissions: Yale admits international students without regard to ability to pay
Yale Scholarship (Need-Based): Covers 100% of demonstrated financial need
Average award: $60,000-$80,000+ per year
No loans required (grants only; work-study optional)
Families earning <$65,000: Full cost coverage (tuition, housing, meals)
Families earning $65,000-$150,000: Reduced costs based on assessment
Families earning >$150,000: Assessed individually
Additional Support: Winter clothing grants for students from warm climates; unpaid internship/research funding; emergency financial assistance; start-up grants
PhD Programs: Full funding guarantee (~98% of admitted students)
Full tuition coverage
Monthly stipend ($2,500-$3,500+ annually)
Health insurance coverage
